sources.quote: Sec. 57.2.1: 'Chitimacha also has the rare (Gordon [2016]) characteristic that statements have a final rising intonation, and questions have a final falling intonation ... Within a word, the first syllable is always stressed (Swadesh [1946]a: [313]).' BUT footnote 1: 'Because Chitimacha places stress on the final syllable of each word, most American linguists pronounce the English name with final stress ... the modern Chitimacha term for the language is Sitimaxa /si.ti.ma.xa/, with stress on the final syllable.'
